full_page.content:
Page 15
Mrs. Liva Adams - about 38 - hopeless cancer of Jaw and mouth, was enrolled over the phone first. That was 6 mo. ago - .. ..... now
astonishing Drs. etc
Anthony Wujuk - 47 - threatened with nervous break-down. Has wife an three children and widowed mother dependent .... worries too much
Mrs Minnie Wills - 63 - asthma at times quite in agony .. since 20 yrs .
Jan. 3 Mrs. Josephin Kenney - 42 - cancered breast removed Oct. 1936. At that .... time cancer appeared very threatenng - in her spine. She was expected to die any moment with three small children after her. was enrolled at that time ... comes To-day very happy husband to ask prayers of thanksgiving and a high Mass.
June 14 Mrs. K. here To-day .... as if never sick - doing all her own work. Mystery to medicine - Takes 4th Volumn of City of God .... Two Children cross-eyed cured. ... perfect.
Paul J. Schultz - 68 - obstruction in stomach. cancer feared
4th Florian Hollerbach - 24 - Enrolled Tonig very sick ulcers or can- cer feared
Page 16
Mrs. Hoelscher - anxious to sell property - a lot - to help others and herself save themselves .... Some legal technality holding up. Enrolled Poor Souls To-day for that ...
Vincent & Mary Bloomer - infantile Par. of St. Benedicts Sch.
Sadie Regisser - 53 - Spinal - think back bone is broken at end was enrolled Dec. 8th. At that time in bed most the time for 7 mo. is decidedly improving since. here To-
Jan. Ada P. Baker - 69 - Very Peculiar jaw fears operation - some think it cancer.
7 Sevina Carriere - 4 - crooked foot & short leg. One of six small childred - poor people ...
8 Joseph Bresnaw - 46 - missing since Jan. 3 - last Monday. No trace ... Enrolled To-day - oldest son promised perpetual enrollment if word is received about him - 9th no word as yet.
